qa_pairs.question: What are the default storage limits for persistent, object, and shared filesystem storage available through the Digital Research Alliance of Canada's Cloud Rapid Access Service (RAS)?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the Cloud Rapid Access Service (RAS), both compute and persistent instances have a persistent storage limit of 10 TB. Object storage is also capped at 10 TB, but it is currently only available at Arbutus and subject to Resource Allocation Competition (RAC) project requirements. Similarly, shared filesystem storage is limited to 10 TB and is exclusively available at Arbutus.

qa_pairs.question: What are the default duration and renewal periods for compute instances and persistent instances offered by the Digital Research Alliance of Canada's Cloud Rapid Access Service (RAS)?
qa_pairs.answer: For compute instances provided by the Cloud Rapid Access Service (RAS), the default duration is one year with a one-month wall-time. Persistent instances have a default duration of one year and are renewable. Both types of instances have a default renewal period in April, aligning with the Resource Allocation Competition (RAC) allocation period of April to March.
